7 How It Works: RL Dynamics, Reward Shaping & Equations

1. Agent-Environment Loop

At every step (dt = 0.02s, 50 Hz physics), the agent observes an 8D normalized state vector [x/50, y/100, vx/10, vy/10, sin(θ), cos(θ), ω, fuel/fuel0]. The PPO actor-critic network outputs continuous actions in [-1, 1]²:

  • Throttle: u = (a₀ + 1) / 2 ∈ [0, 1], mapping to 0 to 20,000 N thrust.
  • Gimbal angle: φ = a₁ · 15° vectoring the rocket engine.

2. Reward & Potential-Based Shaping

The dense potential function shapes the policy to smoothly guide the rocket towards pad coordinates:

Φ(s) = -(dist/10 + speed/2 + 2·|θ|)
r = γ·Φ(s') - Φ(s) - 0.02·u - 0.01

  • Touchdown Success: +100 bonus for landing with |vy|<2 m/s, |tilt|<0.1 rad.
  • Crash / Flip / Out of bounds: -100 severe terminal penalty.

3. Real Physics Equations

The rigid body dynamics are governed by Newton-Euler 2D planar equations:

m = m_dry + fuel,   I = m·H² / 12
a_x = -(T/m)·sin(θ + φ)
a_y = (T/m)·cos(θ + φ) - g
α = -(L·T·sin(φ)) / I
dm = T / (I_sp · g₀) · dt

Integrated via semi-implicit Euler to ensure energy preservation.
